department: School of Marine, Atmospheric, and Sustainability Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 for full consideration for scholarships and fellowships; the Graduate School portal lists a final deadline of January 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: For Fall admissions, applications received by December 15th will receive full consideration for scholarships and fellowships such as the Graduate Council Fellowship.

also.quote: Marine Atmospheric Sustainability PhD Doctorate Fall 2027 1278 January 1, 2027 January 1, 2027

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but scores are accepted and considered.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required; however, we will accept and consider scores for applicants who feel it strengthens their application.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact with potential advisors is not required before applying but is very strongly encouraged.
supervisor.quote: Although contact with potential advisors is not required before applying, it is very strongly encouraged.

funding.value: Full tuition scholarships and stipends go to most students in the research-based MS and PhD programs, usually through a TA in year one and then an RA.
funding.quote: SoMAS offers full tuition scholarships and stipends to most students in the research-based M.S. and Ph.D. programs.

entry_route.value: Students with a bachelor's degree can apply directly to the PhD; an MS is not required, but MS holders can also apply.
entry_route.quote: Students with bachelor’s degrees can apply directly to the M.A., M.S. or Ph.D. programs. | Students with M.S. degrees can also apply to the Ph.D. program, but an M.S. is not required for entry to the Ph.D. program.

notes: One PhD in Marine, Atmospheric, and Sustainability Sciences with Atmospheric Sciences, Marine Sciences and Sustainability tracks.
name: Marine, Atmospheric, and Sustainability Sciences
